_meta.description: Trigger Google Takeout export for Gemini Apps Activity. Navigates to takeout.google.com, deselects all, selects only Gemini Apps Activity, advances through the export wizard. Google emails a download link asynchronously (minutes to hours).

takeout_url.description: Google Takeout URL — must be logged in as the correct Google account

humanSteps: After skill completes: check email for 'Your Google data is ready to download'
Click the download button in the email to get the archive
NOTE: Google may take minutes to hours to prepare the archive

deselect_all_button.description: Deselect all button to start fresh

chain.note: Fail fast if not logged into Google
Takeout has a long load time with many products
Deselect all Google products to start clean

chain.code: /*cdp*/ (function() { var items = document.querySelectorAll('[data-product]'); var found = []; items.forEach(function(el) { var text = el.textContent; if (text.includes('Gemini') || text.includes('Bard')) { found.push(text.trim().substring(0, 60)); var cb = el.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]') || el.querySelector('mat-checkbox'); if (cb && !cb.checked) { cb.click(); } } }); return { found: found }; })()
chain.note: Find and check Gemini/Bard checkbox via JS (handles Angular mat-checkbox complexity)
Scroll down to find the Next step button
Survey delivery page for button names before final click
Trigger the export — Google will email a download link
Capture confirmation (should say export was requested)
